title: Demographic Fairness in Multimodal LLMs: A Benchmark of Gender and Ethnicity Bias in Face Verification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating face verification accuracy across different ethnicity groups (African, East Asian, South Asian, Caucasian) by prompting MLLMs with image pairs and measuring demographic disparities using False Match Rate (FMR)-based fairness metrics (e.g., FMR differential, FMR ratio, and Gini coefficient) on the IJB-C and RFW datasets.

Evaluating face verification accuracy across male and female groups by prompting MLLMs with image pairs and measuring demographic disparities using False Match Rate (FMR)-based fairness metrics (e.g., FMR differential, FMR ratio, and Gini coefficient) on the IJB-C dataset.
